extensions.description: Paid data is settled over x402 (HTTP 402). The A2A endpoint itself is free.

description: Machine-payable air-quality queries over x402. Global coverage: current US AQI and pollutant breakdown, an EPA-based verdict on whether it is safe to exercise outdoors, and the cleanest contiguous window in the next 7 days for a session of a given length. Modelled data (Copernicus CAMS), not a street-level sensor.
name: AirScout

skills.description: Given a place, returns the current US AQI and pollutants, whether outdoor exertion is advisable under EPA guidance, and the cleanest window ahead to run, walk or train.
examples: is it safe to run outside in Delhi right now
best time to go for a 2 hour walk in Los Angeles today
how much does an AirScout query cost
skills.name: air quality and the best time to be outside

skills.description: Given a place and a session length, returns the cleanest contiguous window in the next 7 days to run, walk, cycle or train outdoors.
examples: when is the cleanest 2 hour window in Delhi this week
best day to run outside in Los Angeles
cleanest morning to cycle in Milan
skills.name: the cleanest window ahead to be outside

skills.description: The per-pollutant breakdown behind the index — PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, CO and UV — so a caller sensitive to one of them can act on that rather than on a single composite number.
examples: what is the pm2.5 in Spokane
which pollutant is worst in Delhi right now
skills.name: which pollutant is driving the air quality
